interest: Shows US monitoring of Japanese military activity near Portuguese Macau after 1941 landings on the adjacent Kwangtung coast.
overview: Two 1941 cross-reference sheets from Hong Kong: a report on Japanese activity in Macau, and Despatch No. 859 on the impact of Japanese landings on Macau's security.

people.name: Addison E. Southard
people.role: U.S. Consul General at Hong Kong

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing a February 20, 1941 report from Hong Kong regarding Japanese activities in Macau.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference (Feb 1941): Consul Southard reports from Hong Kong on Japanese activity in Macau.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet: Report on Japanese Activities in Macau

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing Despatch No. 859 from Hong Kong concerning the effect of Japanese landings on the Kwangtung coast on the colony of Macao.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Despatch 859 (1941): Japanese landings on the Kwangtung coast and their effect on Macau, with Consul Ward's visit.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet: Despatch No. 859 on Effect on Macao of Japanese Landing on Kwangtung Coast
